title: Run_Record
description: One execution of computation code inside a Project (spec mathmodel-parity-and-beyond, requirement 16). Stored as <project>/.modelforge/runs/<runId>.json. Written by the kernel (crates/goose-mcp/src/modeling/run_record.rs) and read by the desktop (ui/desktop/src/utils/runRecord.ts); both implement the checks below by hand and are tested against fixtures/run-record-vectors.json. Readers ignore unknown properties; writers of schemaVersion 1 emit exactly the properties listed here, in this order.

runId.description: Unique inside the Project: local start time YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSmmm, a dash and 6 random characters.

inputs.description: Input files in discovery order. At most 1000; inputsTruncated is true when more were found.

config.description: Model and runtime identifiers. Never contains credential values (requirement 16.2).

command.description: The full command line, with Credential_Store values replaced by their Secret_Reference.

seed.description: The random seed as given, or the literal 未设置 when none was set.

exitCode.description: Process exit code; null after a timeout or a user cancellation.

failure.description: Optional; a missing value reads as null. Must agree with exitCode, see allOf.

outputs.description: Output files. At most 1000; outputsTruncated is true when more changed.

allOf.description: Success: no failure and exit code 0.
A non-zero exit keeps the exit code.
Timeouts and cancellations have no exit code.
A truncated list holds exactly the maximum number of entries.

projectPath.description: Project-relative path with / separators, Unicode NFC as written by the kernel. Not absolute, no drive letter, no NUL, and no .. segment (split on / and \).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 with milliseconds and a UTC offset, for example 2026-09-20T10:15:30.123+08:00.
